courses.title: Machig Labdrön's Longevity Sadhana
courses.description: An online weekend on Zoom in which Lama Tsultrim Allione transmits a longevity practice she received in Machig Labdrön's cave in Bhutan in 2017. It includes a guru yoga of Machig Labdrön and the practice of eight-armed Ushnishavijaya with breath, mantra and visualisation; previous sadhana and Vajrayana experience is recommended.

courses.title: Facing the Fear of Death Through Feeding Your Demons
courses.description: A two-hour online session with Lopön Robin Gayle on how our relationship with death changes through life and how speaking openly about fear of mortality can ease it. It ends with a guided Feeding Your Demons meditation, the five-step practice Lama Tsultrim Allione adapted from an ancient Tibetan practice.

flags: Longevity Sadhana: the page says the practice retrieves life force 'lost or stolen due to trauma' and 'revitalizes and reinforces the body's life force, thereby increasing longevity'. Read as a traditional Vajrayana long-life practice, not a claim to treat a disease; kept under the new rule.

Facing the Fear of Death: led by Lopön Robin Gayle, a psychotherapist, but it is a Buddhist Feeding Your Demons session, not therapy; the page carries Tara Mandala's disclaimer that its teachers are not offering mental health services. Kept.
